name: AphX
summary:
# The world is your play-place.

Inspired by Chemp Physics by XORWIRE Games, and Bonelab by Stress Level Zero, Aphx is a physics based gorilla-tag style movement game which you can build stuff, or just mess around. 

MULTIPLAYER!
We have added multiplayer so now you dont have to mess around alone, you can mess around with friends! You can join a specific room code, or join a public server and mess with **up to 20 people!**

Thank you XORWIRE Games for making this possible.
